# @rohan9024/llmrouter

> Zero-dependency, in-process TypeScript LLM router with reliability, capability filtering, adaptive routing, and an agent-first CLI.

## Install
- npm: `npm install @rohan9024/llmrouter`
- Agent Skill: `npx skills add rohan9024/llmrouter --skill llmrouter`
- Quick Setup: `npx @rohan9024/llmrouter init --yes && npx @rohan9024/llmrouter doctor --json`
